verses.text: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon. Sit on the ground with no throne, daughter of the Chaldeans. Nobody will call you tender and delicate anymore.
Take up the millstones and grind flour. Take off your veil, pull up your skirt, bare your legs, and wade through the rivers.
You'll be stripped bare, and everyone will see your shame. I'll take vengeance and won't spare anyone.”
The one who redeems us is the Holy One of Israel. His name is the LORD of Armies.
“Sit quiet and go into the dark, daughter of the Chaldeans. Nobody will call you the queen of kingdoms anymore.
I was angry with my people. I let my inheritance be profaned and handed them over to you. You showed them no mercy. You put an especially heavy load on the elderly.
You said, ‘I'll be a princess forever,’ so you never took any of this to heart or thought about how it would end.
“Now listen, you who live for pleasure and sit there feeling safe. You tell yourself, ‘It's all about me. There's nobody besides me. I'll never be a widow or know what it's like to lose my children.’
Both things will hit you in one moment, on a single day. You'll lose your children and become a widow. They'll hit you with full force despite all your magic and all those spells.
You trusted your wickedness and said, ‘Nobody sees me.’ Your wisdom and knowledge led you crooked. Deep down you said, ‘It's all about me. There's nobody besides me.’
So disaster will come on you, and you won't know when it breaks. Trouble will land on you and you won't be able to get rid of it. Ruin you can't explain will come out of nowhere.
“Go on, stand there with all the spells and magic you've worked at since you were young. See if any of it helps you. See if it lets you win.
You're worn out from all your advisers. Let your astrologers, stargazers, and people who predict the future month by month stand up and save you from what's coming.
Look, they're like dry stubble. Fire will burn them up. They can't save themselves from the flames. This won't be a coal to warm your hands at or a fire to sit beside.
That's what you'll get from everything you worked at. The people who've done business with you since you were young will wander off, each their own way. Nobody will be there to save you.
